title: Travel: John Lennon – Palma de Mallorca to Paris | 1971
content:
The day after they were arrested in Palma de Mallorca, on 24 April 1971 John Lennon and Yoko Ono left Spain and flew to Paris.

Their assistant Dan Richter, who was with them in Mallorca, booked the flights to France under the name Mr and Mrs Smith and friend.

Before leaving, Lennon and Ono spoke to Don Short of the Daily Mirror.

We came here quite openly. How could we kidnap Kyoko when her father holds her passport?

It has taken us two years to nail down Kyoko’s whereabouts. We heard accidentally through friends and so we came out here to see her.

John Lennon

Lennon, Ono, and Richter returned to England on 25 April, before flying to Trinidad the next day.
